# LIGHTSPEED receiver 046D:C547 ("USB Receiver"), single-device receiver, with
# a linked but idle PRO X Superlight on slot 1 that answers its ping slowly.
#
# Shape from owner trace 2026-11-23: the receiver answers its register 0x00
# read; slots 2..6 answer the ping with HID++ 1.0 error 0x08 at once; the slot-1
# ping `10 01 00 1B 00 00 5A` was answered after 443, 937 and 1 288 ms in three
# starts (this transcript uses 1 288 ms, beyond the old 1 s timeout). The trace
# came from the slot ping sweep, which is now only the fallback: here the
# register 0x02 write (Solaar receiver.py notify_devices) goes unanswered
# (synthetic) so the sweep runs. The mouse's feature indexes, name and unit id
# are the synthetic ones of receiver_mouse_discovery.txt.
#
# Format: `out <short|long> <hex>` is a frame BatterySight writes, `in` one it
# reads, `@t+<ms>` lets time pass and ticks the hub; frames shorter than their
# role (7 / 20 bytes) are zero-padded. The `out` lines after an input are the
# writes that input causes. Each `in` advances the clock by 1 ms.

# t = 0: group arrival, read the receiver's notification flags (1 s timeout).
out short 10 FF 81 00 00 00 00
# t = 1: wireless notifications already on.
in  short 10 FF 81 00 00 01 00
# Ask the receiver to report every paired slot.
out short 10 FF 80 02 02 00 00
# t = 1001: no answer within 1 s: fall back to pinging every slot (4 s timeout).
@t+1000
out short 10 01 00 1B 00 00 5A
out short 10 02 00 1B 00 00 5A
out short 10 03 00 1B 00 00 5A
out short 10 04 00 1B 00 00 5A
out short 10 05 00 1B 00 00 5A
out short 10 06 00 1B 00 00 5A
# Slots 2..6 are empty: error 0x08.
in  short 10 02 8F 00 1B 08 00
in  short 10 03 8F 00 1B 08 00
in  short 10 04 8F 00 1B 08 00
in  short 10 05 8F 00 1B 08 00
in  short 10 06 8F 00 1B 08 00
# t = 2289, 1 288 ms after the ping: still within the device timeout, no write.
@t+1283
# Slot 1 finally answers (protocol 4.2): discovery goes on.
in  long  11 01 00 1B 04 02 5A
out short 10 01 00 0B 00 05 00
in  long  11 01 00 0B 03
out short 10 01 00 0B 00 03 00
in  long  11 01 00 0B 02
out short 10 01 00 0B 10 04 00
in  long  11 01 00 0B 06
out short 10 01 03 0B 00 00 00
in  long  11 01 03 0B 10
out short 10 01 03 1B 00 00 00
in  long  11 01 03 1B 50 52 4F 20 58 20 53 75 70 65 72 6C 69 67 68 74
out short 10 01 03 2B 00 00 00
in  long  11 01 03 2B 03
out short 10 01 02 0B 00 00 00
in  long  11 01 02 0B 00 1A 2B 3C 4D
out short 10 01 06 1B 00 00 00
# 0x1004 fn 1: 80 %, discharging -> registered.
in  long  11 01 06 1B 50 04 00 00
